mobbin:55941e7a-9532-47b7-bbe1-b5f8b7bca.summary: From an idle remote view with camera status, the user starts recording and marks a moment with HiLight. A full-screen confirmation appears, then the live recording screen returns with elapsed timer and stop.
steps: Idle remote view with start record
Recording with timer, stop and HiLight
steal: While idle, a top strip shows remote camera storage remaining (3H:25), Wi-Fi and battery before start. You can check readiness without leaving the control screen.
While recording, the main control changes from a red record circle to a white-ring red-square stop, and an elapsed time label appears above the feed.
HiLight is a one-thumb yellow mark button beside stop. A short full-screen 'HiLIGHT TAGGED' confirms the bookmark without opening a list.
After the tag message closes, a red dot and elapsed timer keep recording status easy to see.
avoid: The idle and recording view is a large black empty plane with tiny mode details (1080|24|10s|W). Faculty need a named room or camera and clear live-preview status, not cryptic capture specs.
mobbin:55941e7a-9532-47b7-bbe1-b5f8b7bca.fit: Mobile and iPad app: the phone wins as a walk-around remote start and stop for room cameras (extends TouchPro; no phone app today). HiLight maps to one-tap timed bookmarks during a live take. Keep a large stop and an unmistakable recording indicator.
